_why: CONSTRUCTED, NOT OBSERVED. Every other fixture in this directory is a verbatim capture; this one is not, and must never be read as evidence of what an install returned. MCP-SURFACE 4 (2026-08-23) describes a case-variant pair of LoRA directories -- 'LoRAgoth\' and 'loragoth\' both listed on a case-insensitive filesystem -- but that 95-entry list was described in prose and never captured. It was already gone by 12.2 (2026-08-24) and is still absent on 2026-08-27 (16.5). The dedupe rule stays, because the filesystem that produces it is unchanged, but its only test has to stand on this file. The entries below are the shape 4 describes, spelled by hand.
_shape: Three real files as a case-insensitive filesystem would enumerate them twice: one adapter under two directory spellings, one adapter present under a single spelling, one non-adapter. Six entries collapse to two selectable adapters in one group.
